commands.text:
pg-regression-radar detects Postgres query performance regressions and
correlates them with GitOps deploy events (ArgoCD, Argo Rollouts, Flux).

Usage:

  pg-regression-radar <command> [flags]

Commands:

  operator    All-in-one mode: Collector + Ingester + Correlation Engine +
              Alerting in a single process. Start here for a quick
              evaluation or a simple single-cluster deployment.
  manager     Kubernetes-native mode: a controller-runtime Manager that
              reconciles PostgresWatch/DeploySource/PerformanceRegression
              CRDs, with leader-election HA. Recommended for production.
  collector   Standalone Postgres metric scraper (pg_stat_statements ->
              Prometheus), without correlation/alerting/webhooks.
  ingester    Standalone deploy-event webhook receiver, without the
              collector/correlation/alerting pieces.
  version     Print version, commit, and build date.
  help        Show this message.

Run 'pg-regression-radar <command> --help' for a command's full flag list
(every command also accepts --version and, except manager, --dry-run).

Docs: https://joao00001.github.io/pg-regression-radar

Usage of operator:
  -adjust-autocorrelation
    	Widen Welch's t-test for serial correlation between consecutive scrapes (effective sample size, Zwiers and von Storch 1995), so correlated noise is not mistaken for a regression — see docs/detection-algorithm.md#controlling-false-positives-across-many-queries
  -alert-format string
    	Notification payload format: slack, teams, pagerduty, or custom — see docs/alerting.md (default "slack")
  -alert-template string
    	Go text/template source (inline) for --alert-format=custom — see docs/alerting.md#custom-format. Alternative to --alert-template-file; takes precedence when both are set
  -alert-template-file string
    	Path to a Go text/template file for --alert-format=custom, when passing the source inline via --alert-template isn't convenient
  -alert-url string
    	Webhook URL for --alert-format=slack/teams/custom; ignored for pagerduty. Falls back to --slack-url when unset
  -alerting-allowed-destinations string
    	Optional strict allowlist for alert destinations: comma-separated exact hostnames, IPs, or CIDRs. When set, --alert-url/--slack-url must target one of these destinations
  -alerting-destination-policy string
    	Destination validation policy for outbound alerts: permissive (default, SSRF blocklist only), allowlist (URL host must appear in --alerting-allowed-destinations), or relay-only (ignore --alert-url, always send to --alerting-destination-policy-relay-url). When empty, per-watch spec.alerting.destinationPolicy takes effect.
  -alerting-destination-policy-relay-url string
    	Fixed relay endpoint used when --alerting-destination-policy=relay-only. Must be a valid http/https URL. Required when the policy is relay-only.
  -capture-plans
    	Capture periodic EXPLAIN (GENERIC_PLAN) plan snapshots for tracked queries and attach a plan-diff summary to detected regressions; requires PostgreSQL 16+ (no-op, logged once, on older servers) and adds one extra planner invocation per tracked query per scrape cycle — see docs/detection-algorithm.md
  -changepoint-tolerance duration
    	Max distance between the E-divisive change point and the deploy timestamp still attributed to that deploy (0 = auto: 20% of window, floor 2m)
  -cluster-name string
    	CloudNativePG cluster name label (default "default")
  -dashboard-addr string
    	HTTP listen address for the read-only dashboard API (see internal/dashboardapi); empty (default) disables it. Serves GET /api/v1/{regressions,deploys,queries,watches}. /api/v1/deploys and /api/v1/queries work regardless of --state-backend. /api/v1/regressions and /api/v1/watches always answer 501 Not Implemented on this binary, which has no Kubernetes client; run the manager (cmd/manager, --dashboard-addr there too) for those.
  -dry-run
    	Validate configuration and Postgres connectivity, then exit without starting any servers
  -dsn string
    	Postgres DSN (required)
  -latency-threshold float
    	Minimum relative latency increase to flag (default 0.2)
  -max-query-text-len int
    	Max query text length (characters) stored per sample before truncation for alerting/fingerprinting (default 200)
  -metrics-listen string
    	HTTP listen address for Prometheus metrics (default ":9090")
  -min-executions int
    	Minimum query executions, summed over the observations, per window; not applied to sample sources that report no call counts (default 100)
  -min-samples int
    	Minimum latency observations (scrape intervals in which the query ran) per window (default 10)
  -multiple-testing string
    	Control the false-discovery rate across the queries of one analysis pass: none (default, each query judged on its own p-value), bh (Benjamini-Hochberg) or by (Benjamini-Yekutieli, valid under any dependence, stricter) — see docs/detection-algorithm.md#controlling-false-positives-across-many-queries (default "none")
  -namespace string
    	Kubernetes namespace label (default "default")
  -otlp-app-attribute string
    	With --source-type=otlp: attribute holding the application name (default service.name)
  -otlp-cluster-attribute string
    	With --source-type=otlp: attribute holding the cluster (default k8s.cluster.name)
  -otlp-encoding string
    	OTLP payload encoding for --otlp-endpoint: protobuf or json (default "protobuf")
  -otlp-endpoint string
    	Export every detected regression as an OTLP log record to this OTLP/HTTP endpoint (e.g. http://otel-collector:4318; /v1/logs is appended). Empty disables the export — see docs/otlp-export.md
  -otlp-gzip
    	Gzip-compress OTLP export request bodies
  -otlp-headers string
    	Headers for --otlp-endpoint as k=v,k2=v2. Falls back to OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_HEADERS then OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS, which keeps credentials out of the process list
  -otlp-image-tag-attribute string
    	With --source-type=otlp: attribute holding the image tag (default container.image.tags, then container.image.tag)
  -otlp-include-failed
    	With --source-type=otlp: also accept spans whose status is ERROR
  -otlp-match-attribute value
    	With --source-type=otlp: key=value that a span (or its resource) must carry to count as a deploy (repeatable; all must match)
  -otlp-namespace-attribute string
    	With --source-type=otlp: attribute holding the Kubernetes namespace (default k8s.namespace.name)
  -otlp-revision-attribute string
    	With --source-type=otlp: attribute holding the revision (default vcs.ref.head.revision, then service.version)
  -otlp-span-name value
    	With --source-type=otlp: span name that represents a deploy (exact match; repeatable). At least one of --otlp-span-name/--otlp-match-attribute is required.
  -otlp-timeout duration
    	Per-attempt timeout for OTLP export requests (default 10s)
  -otlp-timestamp string
    	With --source-type=otlp: span timestamp used as the deploy time: end (default) or start
  -pagerduty-routing-key string
    	PagerDuty Events API v2 routing key; required when --alert-format=pagerduty
  -periodic-detection
    	Also run regression detection on a rolling schedule, independent of any tracked deploy — see docs/periodic-detection.md
  -periodic-interval-minutes int
    	How often a full --periodic-detection pass runs over every tracked query (default 15)
  -periodic-window-minutes int
    	Rolling window --periodic-detection splits in half (recent vs. previous) to look for a regression with no deploy to anchor to (default 60)
  -retention-minutes int
    	How long (minutes) the collector retains in-memory query samples before pruning them; should stay well above 2x --window-minutes (default 180)
  -scrape-interval duration
    	Collector scrape interval (default 1m0s)
  -security-profile string
    	Remote-cluster security profile: controlled (default) or hardened. In hardened mode, spec.remoteClusterSecretRef is rejected outright. (default "controlled")
  -slack-url string
    	Slack incoming-webhook URL for notifications (alias of --alert-url with --alert-format=slack, the default)
  -source-type string
    	Deploy source type: argocd, argo-rollouts, flux, generic, otlp (OTLP/HTTP traces; see --otlp-span-name) (default "generic")
  -state-backend string
    	State persistence backend: memory (default) or postgres (default "memory")
  -state-dsn string
    	Postgres DSN for the state backend (default: reuse --dsn, i.e. store state in the same monitored Postgres; set this to point state at a separate Postgres instance instead)
  -state-prune-interval duration
    	How often to sweep the postgres state backend for records older than --state-retention (default 15m0s)
  -state-retention duration
    	How long to retain samples/events in the postgres state backend before pruning (default 168h0m0s)
  -version
    	Print version information and exit
  -webhook-listen string
    	HTTP listen address for deploy webhooks (default ":8080")
  -webhook-secret string
    	Shared secret for webhook authentication; when set, every POST to /webhook must include this value in the X-Webhook-Token header (401 otherwise). Recommended for internet-facing deployments. Prefer passing this via an environment variable reference rather than a CLI flag to avoid exposure in process listings.
  -window-minutes int
    	Analysis window (minutes before/after deploy) (default 30)

Usage of manager:
  -alerting-allowed-destinations string
    	Optional strict allowlist for PostgresWatch alert destinations: comma-separated exact hostnames, IPs, or CIDRs. When set, spec.alerting.url/spec.slackWebhookUrl must target one of these destinations.
  -alerting-destination-policy string
    	Destination validation policy for outbound alerts: permissive (default, SSRF blocklist only), allowlist (URL host must appear in --alerting-allowed-destinations), or relay-only (ignore CRD URL, always send to --alerting-destination-policy-relay-url). When empty, per-watch spec.alerting.destinationPolicy takes effect.
  -alerting-destination-policy-relay-url string
    	Fixed relay endpoint used when --alerting-destination-policy=relay-only. Must be a valid http/https URL. Required when the policy is relay-only.
  -attribution-verdict-addr string
    	address for the read-only attribution verdict endpoint (GET /api/v1/attribution/verdict), e.g. :8082, which a rollout controller's analysis can poll; disabled when empty. Only the leader serves it. See docs/attribution-engine.md
  -cluster-health-check-interval duration
    	How often each registered PostgresRadarCluster's kubeconfig is re-validated against its remote API server (a lightweight discovery version probe — see docs/multi-cluster.md#cluster-health-checks). A kubeconfig rotation (Secret update) also triggers an immediate re-check regardless of this interval. Must be positive. (default 5m0s)
  -dashboard-addr string
    	Address the read-only dashboard API (see internal/dashboardapi) binds to. Empty (default) disables it. Serves GET /api/v1/regressions and /api/v1/watches, listing PerformanceRegression/PostgresWatch via this manager's Kubernetes client — unlike --webhook-bind-address/--pg-metrics-bind-address, it is not gated behind leader election, since it only reads the API server, not per-replica in-memory state. /api/v1/deploys and /api/v1/queries always answer 501 Not Implemented here; run the operator (cmd/operator, --dashboard-addr there too) for those.
  -dry-run
    	Validate that a Kubernetes API server config can be resolved (in-cluster or via kubeconfig), then exit without starting the manager.
  -health-probe-bind-address string
    	Address the liveness/readiness probe endpoint binds to. (default ":8081")
  -leader-elect
    	Enable leader election for controller manager. Enabling this ensures there is only one active set of PostgresWatch/DeploySource workers across all replicas, with automatic failover via a coordination.k8s.io Lease. Disable only for local development. (default true)
  -leader-election-namespace string
    	Namespace the leader election Lease is created in. Defaults to the manager's own namespace when running in-cluster (via the downward API / in-cluster config).
  -metrics-bind-address string
    	Address the controller-runtime metrics endpoint binds to (reconcile/workqueue metrics). Use :8443 for HTTPS, :8080 for HTTP, or 0 to disable. (default "0")
  -pg-metrics-bind-address string
    	Address the aggregated Postgres query metrics endpoint (one Collector's worth per active PostgresWatch) binds to. Served only by the leader. (default ":9090")
  -security-profile string
    	Remote-cluster security profile: controlled (default) or hardened. In hardened mode, spec.remoteClusterSecretRef is rejected outright. (default "controlled")
  -version
    	Print version information and exit
  -webhook-bind-address string
    	Address the deploy-event webhook listener (one route per DeploySource CR) binds to. Served only by the leader. (default ":8080")
  -zap-devel
    	Development Mode defaults(encoder=consoleEncoder,logLevel=Debug,stackTraceLevel=Warn). Production Mode defaults(encoder=jsonEncoder,logLevel=Info,stackTraceLevel=Error) (default true)
  -zap-encoder value
    	Zap log encoding (one of 'json' or 'console')
  -zap-log-level value
    	Zap Level to configure the verbosity of logging. Can be one of 'debug', 'info', 'error', 'panic' or any integer value > 0 which corresponds to custom debug levels of increasing verbosity
  -zap-stacktrace-level value
    	Zap Level at and above which stacktraces are captured (one of 'info', 'error', 'panic').
  -zap-time-encoding value
    	Zap time encoding (one of 'epoch', 'millis', 'nano', 'iso8601', 'rfc3339' or 'rfc3339nano'). Defaults to 'epoch'.

Usage of collector:
  -cluster-name string
    	CloudNativePG cluster name (default "default")
  -dry-run
    	Validate configuration and Postgres connectivity, then exit without starting any servers
  -dsn string
    	Postgres DSN (required)
  -listen string
    	Prometheus metrics listen address (default ":9090")
  -max-query-text-len int
    	Max query text length (characters) stored per sample before truncation for alerting/fingerprinting (default 200)
  -namespace string
    	Kubernetes namespace (default "default")
  -retention-minutes int
    	How long (minutes) to retain in-memory query samples before pruning them; should stay well above the correlation window(s) analysed against this data (default 180)
  -scrape-interval duration
    	Scrape interval (default 1m0s)
  -version
    	Print version information and exit

Usage of ingester:
  -app-name string
    	Filter events to a specific application name (empty = all)
  -cluster-name string
    	Kubernetes cluster identity to stamp on DeployEvents when the webhook payload doesn't carry one (e.g. Argo Rollouts, Flux without eventMetadata)
  -dry-run
    	Validate configuration, then exit without starting the webhook server
  -listen string
    	HTTP listen address for webhook endpoint (default ":8080")
  -otlp-app-attribute string
    	With --source-type=otlp: attribute holding the application name (default service.name)
  -otlp-cluster-attribute string
    	With --source-type=otlp: attribute holding the cluster (default k8s.cluster.name)
  -otlp-image-tag-attribute string
    	With --source-type=otlp: attribute holding the image tag (default container.image.tags, then container.image.tag)
  -otlp-include-failed
    	With --source-type=otlp: also accept spans whose status is ERROR
  -otlp-match-attribute value
    	With --source-type=otlp: key=value that a span (or its resource) must carry to count as a deploy (repeatable; all must match)
  -otlp-namespace-attribute string
    	With --source-type=otlp: attribute holding the Kubernetes namespace (default k8s.namespace.name)
  -otlp-revision-attribute string
    	With --source-type=otlp: attribute holding the revision (default vcs.ref.head.revision, then service.version)
  -otlp-span-name value
    	With --source-type=otlp: span name that represents a deploy (exact match; repeatable). At least one of --otlp-span-name/--otlp-match-attribute is required.
  -otlp-timestamp string
    	With --source-type=otlp: span timestamp used as the deploy time: end (default) or start
  -postgres-watch-ref string
    	PostgresWatch to associate events with
  -source-name string
    	Unique name for this DeploySource (default "default")
  -source-type string
    	Webhook source type: argocd, argo-rollouts, flux, generic, otlp (OTLP/HTTP traces; see --otlp-span-name) (default "generic")
  -version
    	Print version information and exit
  -webhook-secret string
    	Shared secret for webhook authentication; when set, every POST to /webhook must include this value in the X-Webhook-Token header (401 otherwise). Recommended for internet-facing deployments. Prefer passing this via an environment variable reference rather than a CLI flag to avoid exposure in process listings.
